products.name: Google Vertex AI
products.note: Unified ML platform; Model Garden; AutoML; MLOps lifecycle; BigQuery integration; TPU support

profile_text.body:
Google Cloud is the cloud computing and artificial intelligence division of Alphabet Inc., a public company trading under the ticker GOOGL (CIK 0001652044). Its website describes the platform as offering AI and cloud computing services spanning security, data management, and hybrid and multi-cloud environments. The site positions Google Cloud as a destination for businesses building AI agents and generative AI applications, citing access to over 200 foundation models and an ecosystem of AI partners.

The company's primary tracked AI product is Google Vertex AI, a unified machine learning platform that incorporates Model Garden, AutoML, MLOps lifecycle tooling, BigQuery integration, and TPU support. The site also describes an Agent Platform, characterized as a fully managed AI development environment for building and managing AI applications and agents, with access to Agent Studio and the same pool of 200-plus foundation models. Google Cloud additionally promotes a suite of Gemini products for businesses and developers, including a Gemini Enterprise application.

The site offers Best Buy as a named customer example, describing that organization as using Google Cloud generative AI to power virtual assistants, with the stated effect of freeing customer care agents to handle tasks such as troubleshooting product issues, changing order delivery and schedules, and managing subscriptions. No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filings beyond the company's public identity are recorded in the held facts.
